name: logicpilot
description: Codex-native RTL/HDL design and review skills.

interface.shortDescription: Codex-native RTL/HDL design and review skills
interface.longDescription: Five focused skills covering RTL and interface design, source audit, reset/CDC/RDC, timing constraints, verification, synthesis, and FPGA optimization without imposing a parallel build system.
defaultPrompt: Audit this RTL with LogicPilot and explain the findings.
Review this design's clock and reset crossings with LogicPilot.
Analyze this synthesis report and propose a measured RTL improvement.
